Zero verified opportunities is the correct and honest output. This is not fixable by changing search strategy, trying mirrors, or retrying - it requires a human to widen the network egress allowlist for this scheduled routine's environment (at minimum *.greenhouse.io, *.ashbyhq.com, *.lever.co, and individual company domains like stripe.com, www.databricks.com, www.metacareers.com, www.openai.com, www.ycombinator.com, www.google.com).
